message.content:
Here’s a mix of classics, modern hits, and hidden gems you might enjoy:

| # | Title | Year | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|--------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** (1980) | A psychological masterpiece with iconic imagery and unsettling atmosphere. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** (2018) | A slow‑burn dread that culminates in a truly shocking finale. |
| 3 | **Get Out** (2017) | Sharp social commentary wrapped in a suspenseful thriller. |
| 4 | **Midsommar** (2019) | A daylight horror that turns the genre on its head. |
| 5 | **It Follows** (2014) | A fresh take on the “invisible threat” trope with a creepy soundtrack. |
| 6 | **The Babadook** (2014) | Psychological terror that feels personal and deeply affecting. |
| 7 | **A Quiet Place** (2018) | Tension built around silence—perfect for a nerve‑wracking night. |
| 8 | **The Conjuring** (2013) | A well‑crafted haunted house story that still feels fresh. |
| 9 | **The Others** (2001) | A twisty, atmospheric film that keeps you guessing until the end. |
|10 | **The Cabin in the Woods** (2012) | A meta‑take that subverts expectations while delivering solid scares. |

Feel free to pick one or two depending on how intense you want the night to be!
